President Trump's warning was clear: **["I'll get impeached if we lose."](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/imczesvAgEs2PKTEL-3hTgHtFIwse-6VofR65pe7_Lu9Yyo6GS9XfDML6a-YVY00D_6F11USpXAJ8BFbl8HIuNhwbxoRJViGJXbCzFBpDN7gDv98onpxxi9SgsJ1d7ycFXJUTW5hktkb51Pn9zNtZNHvp4PKgNUFubjm8cluMkDW_isjFqBkmIG_bhsKqimHaJzQIWIorCbJeIILKYvUs2TLj_6FD-EQkexbwHCy5zFb2Fp4pwUelO4iU7U005QzT5hOWERPemnx3-cUT3uaMGxNGTvW9sLmwPq1nzGDA56o2vyp1z1Neahq7dV0ru8lua8ifVpKmfamgmsiOUEhevVhWI-HzlCoeoOGcaRKa4FCKTcpLkYX4ym4yWA_Z9kxQx4DYm0watESAvRfsV1nVD24a5n2wqQ2SdoqqQ3VNer0vp6CSLW3cf2NnPKKXUGYv23qr2souehPwM9yrcfUp7MKcDByz89AvtiIFoKpkpiJZTKTJdXi3jlOYNMZZZVLdIt9Ok89SXYbErJP-QWhXxSGIJ9_U96C8Pa-tT5sGo0J8djIdOMP79DErmI/mAYp-NIffkqlN0lbv8zjTL9xF9ldRwUh/17)**

|
---

Peter,
Our volunteers aren’t taking Gov. Ron DeSantis’s latest extreme scheme to gerrymander the Sunshine State’s congressional map lying down.
Right now, Redistricting Action and a coalition of partners are taking action, holding monthly trainings where Floridians can learn about the legislative process and how to get involved, supporting rallies on the ground, and providing 24/7 info on the best ways to speak out for the fair maps movement.
We’re showing up anywhere and everywhere to resist efforts to make Florida’s map even more overtly partisan and racially biased than it already is — and with a special legislative session planned to rush through a new gerrymander, this fight is happening, whether we like it or not.
In normal times, Florida wouldn’t even be considering redistricting. In fact, DeSantis already pushed through an appallingly gerrymandered map just four years ago — one that eliminated the state’s only Black-majority district. Should the latest DeSantis push be successful, Florida would get even more unfairly skewed, and further rob Black and brown communities of fair representation.
We can’t let this happen again.
Your support _directly funds_ our efforts to mobilize voters wherever representative democracy is under attack. And we need your support urgently today.

subject: What if you could avoid the retirement "I should've" moments?
body:

Too many people reach retirement with a nagging thought: "I wish I had made different moves earlier." The truth is, it's not one big decision that leads to regret. It's a bunch of smaller ones. The things that felt like they could wait. Waiting to save. Claiming benefits too soon. Avoiding long-term care planning. Underestimating how debt or career shifts could affect your future. These missed chances don't just cost money. They can cost freedom, flexibility, and peace of mind.

|

body:
| | | | | | Tom Malinowski is a foreign policy leader, defender of democracy, and a fighter who delivered for his constituents. Now, he is running for New Jersey’s 11th District to make sure NJ families keep more of what they earn by cutting costs, and to stand up to the Trump administration’s lawlessness and corruption. If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-gP0Xd1LL-Lub7Gk22PHy9ZqUUjTeU-5uvX4puZKA45ePiRSxLGZZwkpf8vViyXjTA3UQvAak3OSl6J58eskcqi3Ns4dHWVbZ1iQYxASi3EFmlJviBD3YyWhzAQtFIasdcE-2JzlXfyma2qwcBIO9dConxvD-8jTHxTtREpXMXT58HOb2sCVHe8YrZXp3ykmNWd6Ceg_cGod2JydYjfsUHt72gfcb53FVkcOihM73kygrV_d8bUanq8XQACrtxQUo2qUyMFYPFe9NFo-QI4jmLCMkOlvdmru3_i5pLuzUXc8VAjJx9hv0vPydWosUoYmreWg6zPCLIONwFgJb2TJ2B7rYlioMDF8qWFdv_oq4EZ9uX9K3uvVaZT1kh9wAITkkF6JbYbZZ0ESfhblFx2KJZ/4o1/YCFQpfBuTIipA_qbOaoDWg/h0/h001.KKyTYMkKwyvdcSD2NGjqYNBORGnbiIeGwx3yoQ_4xqM)

---

Today, I conceded the race in our NJ-11 special election primary. While this is obviously not the result we wanted, I want you to know how grateful I am to you for believing in me and for your support and encouragement these last few weeks.

The winner of the race, Analilia Mejia, deserves unequivocal credit for running a positive campaign and for inspiring so many voters on Election Day. I hope you will support her in special general election in April. It is essential that we send a Democrat to Washington to fill this seat, not a rubber stamp for Trump.

Unfortunately, the outcome of our race cannot be understood without also taking into account the massive flood of dark money that AIPAC spent on dishonest ads, which falsely accused me of supporting Trump’s immigration crackdown, during the last three weeks. I wanted so much to be able to tell you today that this effort, which was meant to intimidate Democrats across the country, failed in NJ-11.

But the huge difference between the early vote, which we were winning comfortably, and the Election Day vote, suggests that it had a major effect. I met several voters in the final days of the campaign who had seen the ads and asked me, sincerely: “Are you MAGA? Are you for ICE?”

I come away from this experience believing even more strongly that unlimited dark money poses a threat to our democracy — whether it’s being spent by AIPAC or by special interests like the cryptocurrency and artificial intelligence lobbies. These groups demand that members of Congress pledge 100% fealty to their unpopular positions or risk being destroyed by a massively funded deluge of personal attacks. Our Democratic Party must have the courage to stand up to these groups. We must remember that they need us — so that they can pretend to be bipartisan — much more than we need them. The American people will be with us if we do.

My beliefs don’t change based on who is supporting or attacking me. I’m proud that we ran a campaign that stayed true to our convictions, and thankful to everyone who volunteered, donated, and voted. I trust you will continue to pour your heart and soul into the cause of restoring decency and democracy to the country we love, including by supporting good Democrats in this year’s midterm elections. My work, too, is far from finished. I look forward to seeing you on the trail!

Thank you as always,

Tom Email

Now, he is running for New Jersey’s 11th District to make sure NJ families keep more of what they earn by cutting costs, and to stand up to the Trump administration’s lawlessness and corruption. If you’d like to unsubscribe, Today, I conceded the race in our NJ-11 special election primary. While this is obviously not the result we wanted, I want you to know how grateful I am to you for believing in me and for your support and encouragement these last few weeks. The winner of the race, Analilia Mejia, deserves unequivocal credit for running a positive campaign and for inspiring so many voters on Election Day. I hope you will support her in special general election in April. It is essential that we send a Democrat to Washington to fill this seat, not a rubber stamp for Trump. Unfortunately, the outcome of our race cannot be understood without also taking into account the massive flood of dark money that AIPAC spent on dishonest ads, which falsely accused me of supporting Trump’s immigration crackdown, during the last three weeks. I wanted so much to be able to tell you today that this effort, which was meant to intimidate Democrats across the country, failed in NJ-11. But the huge difference between the early vote, which we were winning comfortably, and the Election Day vote, suggests that it had a major effect. I met several voters in the final days of the campaign who had seen the ads and asked me, sincerely: “Are you MAGA? Are you for ICE?” I come away from this experience believing even more strongly that unlimited dark money poses a threat to our democracy — whether it’s being spent by AIPAC or by special interests like the cryptocurrency and artificial intelligence lobbies. These groups demand that members of Congress pledge 100% fealty to their unpopular positions or risk being destroyed by a massively funded deluge of personal attacks. Our Democratic Party must have the courage to stand up to these groups. We must remember that they need us — so that they can pretend to be bipartisan — much more than we need them. The American people will be with us if we do. My beliefs don’t change based on who is supporting or attacking me. I’m proud that we ran a campaign that stayed true to our convictions, and thankful to everyone who volunteered, donated, and voted. I trust you will continue to pour your heart and soul into the cause of restoring decency and democracy to the country we love, including by supporting good Democrats in this year’s midterm elections. #
Peter —
I know we’ve sent a number of fundraising emails about our final FEC fundraising deadline tomorrow, so before we ask any more, I owe you an explanation for why your support is so important.
When I launched this campaign, I knew we were the underdogs taking on a broken system rigged by corporate PACs and billionaire mega-donors.
I have never run for federal or statewide office. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a network of mega-donors who could write big checks to this campaign. And I refused to take part in the corruption of corporate PAC money.
Most politicians rely on this kind of Big Money. They sit in windowless rooms all day calling ultra-wealthy donors before going to fancy fundraisers in the evening.
But I believe that the only way we flip Texas is with a true people-powered movement. Power comes from all of us — coming together to take back power for ourselves.
And while I wish it weren’t true, it does require significant resources to compete with our opponents and their corporate PACs.
These Senate races are ridiculously expensive. And with the final FEC deadline of our primary tomorrow, we have to prove that our movement has what it takes not just to compete — but to win this whole thing.

name: Seth Moulton
subject: Marking Black History Month.
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/74758/images/Email%20Wrapper%20Header%203.png]

Hi friend,

Black history is American history. It’s the expansion of democracy, the fight for equal justice under the law, and the work of building a country that often falls short of its loftiest expectations but always strives to improve and build a more perfect union.

Here in Massachusetts, that history is woven into everyday life: in our neighborhoods, our music, our faith communities, and our sports. Bill Russell didn’t just change basketball in Boston. He demanded civil rights and respect in a city and a country still learning how to live up to its ideals.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/74758/images/IMG_3354.jpg]

Last month, on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, I joined community members in Boston and on the North Shore at Embrace Honors MLK 2026, the MLK Jr. Memorial Breakfast, and local events rooted in service and faith. These gatherings were reminders that honoring history isn’t about ceremony. It’s about responsibility.

That responsibility includes confronting the ways Black Americans were denied opportunities they earned. For years, I’ve co-sponsored the GI Bill Restoration Act with Congressman Jim Clyburn to restore education, housing, and economic benefits to Black World War II veterans and their families who were excluded when they came home. The impact of that exclusion is still felt today in generational wealth gaps.

While it’s important to acknowledge where our country has fallen short, Black history is about so much more. It’s about the culture, community, excellence, and leadership that Black Americans have built that continue to shape our entire country.

I’m proud to stand beside Black leaders across Massachusetts in celebrating those contributions and continuing to build a future that better reflects the lofty goals upon which our country was founded.

— Seth
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/74758/images/moulton-header-headshot-3.jpg]

Seth Moulton is a Marine and a Democrat with a mission to bring a new generation of leaders to Congress. Seth’s two young daughters, Emmy and Caroline, remind him every day why new leadership and urgent action can’t wait any longer.

* * *
I've now watched every video of the members of Congress who had the chance to review the allegedly "unredacted" Epstein files last night. And almost every single one of them looked visibly shaken by what they saw. I especially want to shout out Congressman Khanna and Congressman Massie for continuing to push for the truth--alongside others from both parties.
The more I hear about the sheer horror of what the Trump administration is covering up--from Trump lying about his relationship with Epstein, to a nine-year-old victim in the files who may never see justice, to guys like Howard Lutnick (Trump's Commerce Secretary) who've been lying for years about their connections, to the still-unknown co-conspirators--the more I feel this overwhelming swell of rage and grief.
There's not even a word for how I felt this morning, dropping my kid off at school, just fuming. Fuming at how this country has failed to deliver justice for predators who abused children. And yeah, maybe I've said some of this before--but that's because this shit is just that depressing.
Here's the realization that's been crystallizing for me: all these scandals we're living through--this economic crisis crushing working people, Tulsi Gabbard's weird election meddling play, Trump's never-ending stream of corruption and pardons, and the Epstein saga--it's all the same scandal. It's the same story.
It's the Epstein class and their defenders--the wealthy, powerful, well-connected elite who protect each other no matter what crimes they commit. The ones who abuse children with impunity, loot the working class, and oversee the largest wealth transfer in American history. And when those crimes start to surface, they flood the zone with manufactured chaos and scandal to exhaust us, distract us, and make accountability feel impossible--knowing that if they're ever caught, a pardon is waiting from Donald Trump. As precedent has made clear.
These are the people who want us at each other's throats. They tell me I'm supposed to hate you because you voted for someone I despise. They tell you to hate me too. They want us to cut off our families, to abandon our friends over politics--so we're too divided to see the real crimes happening right in front of our faces.
And it is right in front of our faces. Blatant. Brazen. Maddening.
So let me be real: as frustrated as I get with folks who voted for Trump in 2024--including people in my own family--I don't hate them. I don't hate them. I'm done fighting yesterday's wars.
Because at this point, there are only two classes in America: the Epstein class and its enablers--and everybody else. And if you want to be part of "everybody else," and you're serious about fixing this mess? You're my brother. You're my sister. The strongest form of resistance is solidarity, listening long enough to be heard in return.
* * *

* * *
I'm a proud Democrat, but I'm not blind. There's rot in my party too. There are people in those files who wear the same label I do--and they deserve exactly the same level of accountability.
So no, I don't get rattled when I go on conservative media and they start shouting about Bill Clinton being in the files. Of course he's in the files. And he should be held accountable. If he committed crimes, he should be prosecuted. Fully. I want him and Hillary Clinton to testify publicly. Let's go. The sooner the better.
But this isn't about Clinton. Or Trump. It's not about left or right. Every single name in those files should be dragged into the light. We can go back to yelling about partisan bullshit after we take care of this.
Because there is some real, serious shit going down in this country.
And part of the reason Trump's approval rating is tanking--even in his strongest base among non-college voters--is because people are exhausted. Furious. Fed up. Everyone's getting wrecked by this economy except for a tiny elite. Everyone's horrified by the Epstein files. Murders like those of Alex Pretti and Renee Good are 80-20 issues outside the Twitter echo chamber. And MAGA influencers can't even admit it. That's why their defenses are getting more desperate and stupid--because they know they're cooked.
And the way forward? It's not about yelling louder. It's not about dunking on people, although I enjoy the hell out of that. It's about forgiveness--as hard as that is. It's about being the adult in the room. It's about calling that dad, or cousin, or college buddy you cut off, and just checking in.
I talk to my father almost every day. For 25 years, he's driven me insane on politics. But he's inching closer. Every conversation matters. That was my little act of resistance this morning--and it'll be my act of resistance tomorrow, with him and my mom. And I'm okay with that.
We need more people doing that. Because this moment cannot be defined by partisan division. It has to be defined by clarity. By unity. By the real fight.
And right now, the real fight is about exposing Donald Trump--and exposing this class of people.
Because if we don't, we won't have a country.
A nation that won't hold the powerful accountable for abusing children is not a nation worth preserving.
And yet--I still believe this country is worth fighting for. Even now. Even in my disgust. Even as this rot cuts across parties and presidents and decades.
It's worth fighting for. I'm bringing the rage and sadness into my work today, turning it into action: showing up, pushing back, and refusing to look away.
I hope you do too.

There's not even a word for how I felt this morning, dropping my kid off at school, just fuming. Fuming at how this country has failed to deliver justice for predators who abused children. And yeah, maybe I've said some of this before--but that's because this shit is just that depressing. Here's the realization that's been crystallizing for me: all these scandals we're living through--this economic crisis crushing working people, Tulsi Gabbard's weird election meddling play, Trump's never-ending stream of corruption and pardons, and the Epstein saga--it's all the same scandal. It's the same story. It's the Epstein class and their defenders--the wealthy, powerful, well-connected elite who protect each other no matter what crimes they commit. The ones who abuse children with impunity, loot the working class, and oversee the largest wealth transfer in American history. And when those crimes start to surface, they flood the zone with manufactured chaos and scandal to exhaust us, distract us, and make accountability feel impossible--knowing that if they're ever caught, a pardon is waiting from Donald Trump. As precedent has made clear. These are the people who want us at each other's throats. They tell me I'm supposed to hate you because you voted for someone I despise. They tell you to hate me too. They want us to cut off our families, to abandon our friends over politics--so we're too divided to see the real crimes happening right in front of our faces. And it is right in front of our faces. Blatant. Brazen. Maddening. So let me be real: as frustrated as I get with folks who voted for Trump in 2024--including people in my own family--I don't hate them. I don't hate them. I'm done fighting yesterday's wars. Because at this point, there are only two classes in America: the Epstein class and its enablers--and everybody else. And if you want to be part of "everybody else," and you're serious about fixing this mess? You're my brother. You're my sister. The strongest form of resistance is solidarity, listening long enough to be heard in return. * I'm a proud Democrat, but I'm not blind. There's rot in my party too. There are people in those files who wear the same label I do--and they deserve exactly the same level of accountability. So no, I don't get rattled when I go on conservative media and they start shouting about Bill Clinton being in the files. Of course he's in the files. And he should be held accountable. If he committed crimes, he should be prosecuted. Fully. I want him and Hillary Clinton to testify publicly. Let's go. The sooner the better. But this isn't about Clinton. Or Trump. It's not about left or right. Every single name in those files should be dragged into the light. We can go back to yelling about partisan bullshit after we take care of this. Because there is some real, serious shit going down in this country. And part of the reason Trump's approval rating is tanking--even in his strongest base among non-college voters--is because people are exhausted. Furious. Fed up. Everyone's getting wrecked by this economy except for a tiny elite. Everyone's horrified by the Epstein files. Murders like those of Alex Pretti and Renee Good are 80-20 issues outside the Twitter echo chamber. And MAGA influencers can't even admit it. That's why their defenses are getting more desperate and stupid--because they know they're cooked. And the way forward? It's not about yelling louder. It's not about dunking on people, although I enjoy the hell out of that. It's about forgiveness--as hard as that is. It's about being the adult in the room. It's about calling that dad, or cousin, or college buddy you cut off, and just checking in. I talk to my father almost every day. For 25 years, he's driven me insane on politics. But he's inching closer. Every conversation matters. That was my little act of resistance this morning--and it'll be my act of resistance tomorrow, with him and my mom. And I'm okay with that. We need more people doing that. Because this moment cannot be defined by partisan division. It has to be defined by clarity. By unity. By the real fight. And right now, the real fight is about exposing Donald Trump--and exposing this class of people. Because if we don't, we won't have a country. A nation that won't hold the powerful accountable for abusing children is not a nation worth preserving. And yet--I still believe this country is worth fighting for. Even now. Even in my disgust. Even as this rot cuts across parties and presidents and decades. It's worth fighting for. I'm bringing the rage and sadness into my work today, turning it into action: showing up, pushing back, and refusing to look away. I hope you do too. body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
This month, we lost Lee Hamilton, who represented Indiana in Congress for more than three decades and spent his life thinking deeply about how our democracy actually functions when it’s working. Before his passing, he wrote a remarkable piece [https://indianacitizen.org/hamilton-commentary-congress-needs-more-friendships/] that I hope you’ll take a few minutes to read.
Lee believed that no reform, no rule change, and no procedural fix would restore Congress as a real check on power unless members can build relationships that cross party lines and endure real disagreement. I agree.
https://indianacitizen.org/hamilton-commentary-congress-needs-more-friendships/ [https://indianacitizen.org/hamilton-commentary-congress-needs-more-friendships/]
In 2019, during the first Trump administration, Rep. Thomas Massie and I worked together to pass a bipartisan War Powers Resolution to end U.S. involvement in Yemen. Years later, that same trust helped us lead the bipartisan effort to force the release of the Epstein files.
That didn’t happen because we agreed on everything. It happened because we had built enough trust to pick up the phone, text honestly, and work through differences without posturing.
I hope you’ll take a moment to read Lee Hamilton’s final reflection [https://indianacitizen.org/hamilton-commentary-congress-needs-more-friendships/] . It’s thoughtful, generous, and deeply needed right now.
READ THE OP-ED [https://indianacitizen.org/hamilton-commentary-congress-needs-more-friendships/]
Thank you for your support, your activism, and all that you do.
Onward,
Ro
Wait! One more thing–
Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future.
If you want to support our people-powered campaign as we continue to fight for progress in Washington, please consider making a donation of $3 or more today. Thank you!

name: Mark Kelly
subject: My day in court:
body:
---
Derek, it's Mark. Most of you probably know that I am suing the Secretary of Defense. Last week, I was in court to make my case against Pete Hegseth. After 25 years in uniform and another 5 in the United States Senate, I never imagined I’d have to do something like that. Hegseth has left me no choice. When he censured me and threatened my rank and retirement, he came after what I earned over 25 years — and attempted to chill the free speech rights of every retired member of the military alongside me. If Hegseth isn’t stopped, our longest-serving military veterans will have to live with the constant threat that they could be deprived of their rank and pension years, even decades, after they leave the military if they say something he doesn’t like. I’m not going to sit by and let that happen. So, I sued Hegseth. And now, we wait and see what the court decides. I’ve been truly humbled by the support people have sent my way over the past couple of months. It means the world to me that so many of you care about what Trump and Hegseth are trying to do. That’s how we’ve made it this far, and it’s how we’ll get to the other side of this chapter in our nation’s history. Together. body:
Abigail Spanberger just confirmed the date fair elections get put to a vote.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/131?refcode=em20260210-156&t=1&akid=156%2E12592%2Eot29Y7)
**Our date is set.**
Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger has signed legislation officially setting April 21 as the day voters decide **YES** or no on fair elections. Now, our movement has a clear deadline and a powerful moment to mobilize.
This amendment is about fairness — and who gets to shape our democracy. While MAGA Republicans across the country are working to redraw maps to unfairly lock in power, this amendment puts voters back in control and restores fairness in our elections. By voting YES, voters can weigh in on congressional maps ahead of midterms and protect their representation in Congress.
What happens in Virginia won’t just affect the Commonwealth, **it can also level the playing field nationwide.**
Now that the referendum date is solidified, _every voter_ needs to know what’s at stake. We’re working urgently to educate communities, share accurate information, and make sure everyone in Virginia — and across the country — understands the high stakes of this election.
[**Your donation today will help fund voter outreach, ads, and grassroots organizing efforts in the critical weeks leading up to April 21. # Take Action and Urge Your Congressman to Pass the SAVE Act
---
| | I hope this email finds you and your family well. I'm truly grateful for the incredible support we're seeing across Michigan as we build toward the March endorsement convention and beyond **to take back the Michigan AG’s Office**.
Election integrity is a top priority in Michigan — and that's why I'm **urging Congress to pass the SAVE Act** that’s up for a vote this week.
It’s straightforward and non-negotiable: **it requires proof of U.S. citizenship** to register and vote. It is necessary, it’s long overdue, and **it’s what Michigan voters demand**. Watch my short message [and you can view it by clicking below](https://us.list-manage.com/j7MZ9EAPewr?e=4b10910eed&c2id=dd928428aa6cfabe44bc3913de81e64c):
[****](https://us.list-manage.com/S7-JMuvT7nJ?e=4b10910eed&c2id=dd928428aa6cfabe44bc3913de81e64c)
Please take a moment today to[**call your Member of Congress and urge them to support the SAVE Act**](https://us.list-manage.com/2Tt7RX7I2Xy?e=4b10910eed&c2id=dd928428aa6cfabe44bc3913de81e64c). Ask them to lead the nation on election integrity, protect every citizen's voice, and stand with President Trump. Together, we can make our voices heard.
As Michigan’s next Attorney General, **I’ll fight to secure our elections and defend the rights of every legal voter**. Your right to vote as a citizen should be defended against those that seek to harm our way of life. 🇺🇸

name: Tom Suozzi
subject: Thank You for Joining Us! Recap of the 2026 Coordinated Summit.
body:
Read more >>

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | |
Dear Friends,Thank you to everyone who joined us this past Saturday at The Milleridge Inn for the 2026 NY-03 Coordinated Summit! The event was a tremendous success, and the energy in the room made it clear that we are ready to take on the 2026 election cycle with strength and unity.Together with local elected officials, candidates, Democratic Clubs, and our dedicated volunteers, we engaged in a vital discussion about our strategy and coordination for the upcoming campaign season.For those who were unable to attend, here are a few key highlights from the summit:
* **Unified Strategy:** We laid the groundwork for a coordinated effort across NY-03 to ensure our message reaches every voter.
* **Mobilization:** Leaders discussed the importance of early volunteer engagement and the specific roles our Democratic Clubs will play in the coming months.
* **Momentum:** The focus remained on the high stakes of the November 2026 elections and the collective action needed to ensure success.

**In 2024, I won in NY-03, while Trump won my district by 19,000 votes. Last week, the president endorsed my opponent, calling him a “MAGA Warrior” and spreading lies about my record, even calling me a “Radical Left Wing Lunatic.”** The 2026 elections are quickly approaching and your participation is what will drive us forward. Whether you were there in person or are following along from home, we are grateful for your continued support.If you have any questions or would like to get more involved, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at info@suozziforcongress.com.We look forward to working alongside you in the weeks and months ahead!Best regards,Tom

---
| | **Join 1+ Million US Citizens**

---
| | Hi there,

If you’ve been thinking about getting your concealed carry certification, now is the time to act.

Across the country, lawmakers are shifting laws, some strengthening 2A protections, others tightening requirements.

Either direction leads to one reality:

**[If you’re not concealed carry certified yet, you’re behind.](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/22401/6374453/bcdb71182c5f0e014909f98a94874390fb5c8470/17b61eabfc8c114640e026f4d781a957416fd98c)**

Countrywide Concealed has trained over 1,000,000 law-abiding citizens using a state-approved curriculum that meets your state's requirements and prepares you for responsible carry from day one.
Every course includes:

**[• State-approved training](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/22401/6374453/bcdb71182c5f0e014909f98a94874390fb5c8470/17b61eabfc8c114640e026f4d781a957416fd98c)** that satisfies your state’s education standards
• Clear breakdowns of state handgun laws so you actually understand what applies to you
• Reciprocity guidance that tells you exactly where your permit is valid
• Situational awareness, conflict avoidance, and real-world carry instruction

Whether the next legislative change favors concealed carriers or restricts them, one thing is guaranteed, being certified now puts you in control.

Waiting could mean:
• Longer processing timelines
• Increased demand
• Stricter requirements
• Delays in getting your permit approved

Don’t leave your future up to lawmakers or chance. Join the millions who’ve already taken the step toward legal, responsible concealed carry.

Get your certification training started today.

name: James Carville
subject: Keeping me up at night
body:
Roy’s the candidate who can win in battleground NC.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=533%2E124072%2E1BlTcW)
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5407?t=7&akid=533%2E124072%2E1BlTcW) Hear me out, Peter — North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat is the key to our whole plan to take down the GOP. This race is always on my mind. And it’s got me worried. _You know what about this race keeps me up at night? It’s not the tightening polls._ It’s not the loudmouth pundits. It’s worrying that good people will sit on the sidelines while the GOP tries to buy this seat right out from under us. Democrats were lucky to get our guy. Roy Cooper’s the candidate who can win, and he’s all in on this fight. Swinging hard. But let me tell you something — _he can’t do it by himself._ Roy’s got a MAJOR, make-or-break fundraising deadline _tomorrow._ His team has to file a PUBLIC financial report with the FEC before the primary in NC. And if we let their numbers slip, the GOP is ready to seize the momentum and run away with this whole thing. **[If you can step up, we need you in this fight ASAP. Pitch in whatever you’ve got to help bring in 10,000 individual donations before Roy’s deadline.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5407?t=8&akid=533%2E124072%2E1BlTcW)** | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5407?t=9&akid=533%2E124072%2E1BlTcW)
---
Here’s the deal: Roy’s the guy who looked the Republican legislature in North Carolina dead in the eye and did what was right, even when it wasn’t easy. He fought like hell to get Medicaid Expansion DONE — which has delivered health care to more than 700,000 people. He stood up for voters. For reproductive rights. _He delivered for working families when everyone said it was impossible._
**He’s the kind of fighter we need in the Senate.**
Now, the guy he’s running against? An ex-Big Oil lobbyist who Trump personally selected because he wanted another rubber stamp on the Trump agenda.
**This is the choice, Peter.** A proven leader who delivers results, or a D.C. swamp creature who delivers for corporate donors. And those big-money donors are just _lining up_ ready to drown this state in far-right cash — all to buy a Senate seat for their very own lobbyist. That’s not just obscene. _It’s desperate._
**[But here’s what they don’t get: You can’t beat genuine grassroots support with corporate cash. Not if we step up. Not if we fight back. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| | Donald Trump has turned ICE and CBP into his personal gestapo. His federal agents are murdering American citizens in broad daylight, snatching people off the street into unmarked vans, and terrorizing our communities. This isn't immigration enforcement, it's intimidation. But there's another under-the-radar issue at play here that has me extremely concerned:**the Trump administration is weaponizing private data to track and target American citizens.** As the Senate's resident privacy hawk, I've been warning for years about the dangers of the federal government having unfettered access to Americans' private information, and now, we're seeing exactly how dangerous that is. Here's how I'm fighting back: **1\. ICE is using Palantir apps to collect biometric data on protestors.** This means that Trump's federal agents can track where you go, what you do, and who you talk to. I have a bill to stop them by blocking the feds from getting access to that information. **2\. ICE is purchasing private location and other data from sleazy data brokers through a legal loophole.** Right now, if the U.S. government wants to obtain your location data from a wireless carrier, it has to get a warrant to do so. But there's a little-known legal loophole that allows them to get around that. The federal government can buy up your private information, including your location data, from sleazy data brokers that hoover up your personal info from apps on your phone. | Peter,
Since we launched in spring 2025, we've been sounding the alarm about Trump's plan to rig our elections.
The Constitution is clear. States run elections. That is why MAGA is trying to seize control of state Supreme Courts in key swing states, where these courts have the final say on how elections are administered.
That is why we built Defend Our Courts. And last year in Pennsylvania, we proved it works by helping Democrats hold the Supreme Court and stopping a Trump takeover in the most important swing state in the country.
Now, Trump is turning up the election rigging dial to 11.
First, he sent the FBI into Fulton County, Georgia's election offices and seized 2020 ballots--desperately trying to resurrect his rigged-election conspiracy.
Then he demanded Republicans nationalize elections, handing control of voting to the federal government.
Next, his top advisor and loyal attack dog, Steve Bannon, openly called for Trump to deploy ICE to surround polling places.
And now he's called an unprecedented and shadowy meeting with state election officials to intimidate them:

That is why Defend Our Courts is expanding nationwide this year. With state Supreme Court races in the swing states of Wisconsin, Michigan, and Georgia, the mission has never been more urgent.
We cannot allow Trump even a single opening to seize control of these courts. If he does, free and fair elections are finished.
With more than 100,000 grassroots donors across the country, we are one of the largest forces standing between MAGA and a hostile takeover of our courts. But this fight will be expensive. MAGA is expected to pour massive money into these races, possibly more than into key Senate and House contests.
The goal is simple, and the stakes are existential: defend the courts and save democracy.

subject: Young people are rising up this year

body:
They’re showing up. They’re pissed off. They’re fighting back.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260210-1&t=1&akid=3137%2E587540%2E8xVP6w)
Peter,
I’ll be honest. I was concerned about young people for a moment.
After the low voter turnout in 2024 and fewer young faces in the streets at No Kings protests than I expected, I wondered if maybe a generation that has been called on to show up again and again was starting to check out.
But you know what?
I was wrong. And I am really glad I’m able to say that now.
Young people _are_ showing up. They’re pissed off. They’re ready to fight back.
The Harvard Youth Poll shows something remarkable: Young people are dissatisfied with both political parties — but they trust Democrats more to get the country back on track, and _youth voter turnout in 2026 is expected to surge to its highest rate ever._
Across the country, students are walking out of high schools to protest dangerous federal enforcement actions — including the fatal shootings by ICE agents in Minneapolis that ignited massive demonstrations and condemnation nationwide.
What we’re seeing is a generation waking up, refusing to be quiet, refusing to tolerate violence and injustice, and _taking meaningful action._
It reminds me of 2018 — when young people marched, organized, and demanded gun reform after Parkland. We made change then, and we can do it again. If we wake up, get pissed off, and take meaningful action together.
**That’s exactly what we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve.**
We’re not just complaining — we’re electing a new generation of leaders. Leaders who look like the future, think like the future, and will fight like hell for the future. And these young candidates are inspiring a new generation to vote.
But none of this work happens without support.
**[Will you chip in $5 to power this movement?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260210_1_walkouts._dnvSg&refcode=em20260210-3137&amount=5&t=2&akid=3137%2E587540%2E8xVP6w)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

Peter,

Have you ever heard of medical tourism?

It’s a uniquely American phenomenon. Basically, it’s booking an
international trip specifically seeking medical care.

Like, for example, traveling to South Korea for cancer treatment. Or
Canada for dental care. You get the idea.

Some clinics overseas even offer “medical tourism packages,” so Americans
can get a full check-up at a much cheaper cost.

This is WILD.

In the richest, most powerful country in the world, getting the healthcare
you need shouldn’t require a passport.

And yet, that’s where we are because our healthcare system is designed to
extract as much money as possible, not to keep people healthy.

I’ve spent my career studying this system. I became a doctor. I worked in
public health. I literally wrote the book on Medicare for All.

And I can tell you this with certainty: It does not have to be this way.

Medicare for All would allow every American to get the care they need here
at home.

I’m running for the U.S. Senate to finally make it the law of the land,
but I can only take this fight to Washington if we build the power to win.

Corporate interests will fight Medicare for All at every step, because our
broken system is wildly profitable for them. That’s why this campaign
doesn’t take corporate PAC money, and why grassroots support matters so
much right now.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

subject: Did you change your name when you got married?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
In the U.S., eight in 10 women who marry change their last name. That means there are more than 60 million women in this country whose birth certificates may not have their current legal last names — and thanks to legislation the GOP is pushing this week, that could put their voter registration at risk.
Here’s what’s going on:
First, Republicans tried to pass a bill called the SAVE Act last year that would implement a whole bunch of new voter ID restrictions, making it significantly harder for people to vote. That bill failed — in large part because of massive public backlash.
Now, Trump is panicking about losing the midterms — so he’s pushing his party to try again.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89313/images/SAVE%20Act.png]
Let’s be really clear about why he’s pushing this, because it has nothing to do with election security. It is already illegal for non-citizens to vote in federal elections, and there are pretty strict penalties in place for people who break that law — including deportation. And voter fraud is incredibly rare — statistically, you’re more likely to be struck by lightning than ever witness an instance of voter fraud! The data is clear [https://www.brennancenter.org/topics/voting-elections/vote-suppression/myth-voter-fraud] : it is just not [https://www.brookings.edu/articles/how-widespread-is-election-fraud-in-the-united-states-not-very/] a widespread issue [https://www.npr.org/2024/10/11/nx-s1-5147732/voter-fraud-explainer] .
So if they’re not trying to solve the problem of basically non-existent voter fraud, what are Trump Republicans doing with this new “SAVE America” Act?
Quite simply: make it harder to vote.
→ This legislation requires both a photo ID and documentation that proves American citizenship, like a passport or a birth certificate. Well, roughly half of Americans don’t have a passport. And we already know how problematic the birth certificate situation is — not to mention the fact that millions of people don’t even know where theirs is.
→ The bill would prohibit universal mail voting (like we have here in California), requiring tens of millions of people who usually receive ballots in the mail automatically to submit an application and include copies of their passport or birth certificate (hello, identity theft risk?).
→ It would completely upend online voter registration, which 42 states rely on.
→ It would send election workers to prison for up to five years for helping someone register without all the correct documents — even if that person is a U.S. citizen.
→ Even things like changing your address or your party registration would require you to go in person with certified paper documentation.
Of course, all of this disproportionately impacts younger voters, people of color, and women — and injects total chaos into our very safe and secure elections.
So — Republicans are pushing this right now in Congress and the House is scheduled to vote on it as soon as this week. What can you do about it?
1. I am a hard NO vote on this disenfranchising legislation, but my Republican colleagues need to hear just how much the public opposes this bill. You can see a list of cosponsors here [https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/7296/cosponsors?s=1&r=2] — call the Capitol switchboard at (202) 224-3121 and let these folks know you strongly oppose the SAVE America Act.
2. Arm yourself with the facts about this bill [https://campaignlegal.org/update/what-you-need-know-about-save-act] , and have conversations with friends and family about what it will actually do.
3. Add your name to my petition opposing the SAVE America Act.

We have seen time and again over the past year that public outcries and external pressures CAN make a difference in what the GOP gets done — so please keep speaking out.
Thank you for reading — more to come.
—Sara

Dear Friends and Supporters,
As I hit the campaign trail across Alabama, one thing has become crystal clear: our state is ready for real change. Our campaign is laser focused on BUILDING TRUST. Since launching last April, I have been a consistent critic of this Administration's FISCALLY IRRESPONSIBLE, UNCONSTITUTIONAL, ANTI-ECONOMY, and IMMORAL use of ICE. We've seen time and again how these policies hurt families, strain our resources, and undermine the values that make America great.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/af068875-1a12-48da-93ac-aa4ed93bcebc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And the American people are waking up to it. A poll just came out that shows FIFTY-EIGHT PERCENT of ALABAMIANS DISAPPROVE of what ICE is doing. This isn't just a statistic--it's a DAMNING sign for the future of the MAGA movement in the Deep South. Voters are tired of the division, the waste, and the failures that have defined the last fifteen years of Republican control.
After fifteen years of FAILURES, the folks running the show want Alabamians to double down on the same LOSING BRAND. But I say enough is enough. Alabama deserves leadership that prioritizes trust, fiscal responsibility, and moral integrity. That's why I'm running--to bring a fresh voice to the Senate, one that fights for our communities, our economy, and our Constitution.
Together, we can turn the tide. But campaigns like ours rely on grassroots support from people like you. If you believe in building trust and charting a new path for Alabama, please consider making a donation today. Every dollar helps us spread our message, reach more voters, and build the momentum we need to win.
[Donate Now](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d9eb6397-7b0f-4239-aa81-812b91f64fe3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - Let's make Alabama stronger.

Thank you for standing with me.
In service,
Kyle Sweetser

# Sydney Sweeney rings NYSE bell to celebrate American Eagle successes
Actress Sydney Sweeney **[rang the New York Stock Exchange opening bell](https://substack.com/redirect/f73ab4dc-d953-47d0-85c3-3e37f3647ec4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on February 9, 2026, alongside American Eagle Outfitters CEO Jay Schottenstein, celebrating her viral 2025 "Sydney Sweeney Has Great Jeans" campaign that sparked backlash, boosted sales, and drew praise from President Trump.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f73ab4dc-d953-47d0-85c3-3e37f3647ec4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Viral Campaign Backlash** : The 2025 ad played on "genes" vs. "jeans" with Sweeney explaining genetics before quipping "My jeans are blue," prompting criticism for suggestive wordplay and a company defense emphasizing it was solely about denim.
* **Celebrity Outfit Nod** : Sweeney wore jeans and a light blue denim jacket on the trading floor, directly referencing the campaign slogan while also signing a book and appearing on an NYSE billboard for the brand.
* **Political Endorsement Boost** : President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social calling Sweeney a registered Republican with the "HOTTEST" ad, claiming her jeans were "flying off the shelves" in support.
* **Sweeney 's Magic Market Touch: **Major indexes closed higher on the day with the S&P up 0.5% at 6,964.82. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 0.04% at 50,135.87 and the Nasdaq Composite up 0.9% at 23,238.67.

# Kalshi smashes Super Bowl trading record with $1 Billion
Prediction market platform Kalshi **[shattered records with over $1 billion in trading](https://substack.com/redirect/700421b5-3b21-4876-ac13-aad28d690d1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** **[volume](https://substack.com/redirect/700421b5-3b21-4876-ac13-aad28d690d1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Super Bowl Sunday, a staggering 2,700% surge from the previous year, fueled by massive bets on Bad Bunny's halftime performance and game outcomes amid the Seattle-New England matchup.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/700421b5-3b21-4876-ac13-aad28d690d1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Record-shattering volume** : With daily trading exceeded $1 billion on Super Bowl Sunday, Kalshi marked its highest single-day total ever.
* **Halftime frenzy drives bets** : Wagers on Bad Bunny's first song topped $100 million, with additional performer-related contracts surpassing $45 million.
* **Explosive yearly growth** The Super Bowl volume represented a 2,700% increase over the prior year's event, highlighting rapid platform adoption.
* **Technical hurdles emerge** : High traffic caused delays in user deposits and fund access during the game, though the company assured funds remained secure.

# Alphabet **Google goes Century Bold** with Rare 100-Year Bond out of London
Alphabet is set to issue tech's **[first 100-year bond since the dot-com era,](https://substack.com/redirect/6249cf93-af39-42b7-921b-26beeea089ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a UK Pounds Sterling-denominated ultra-long tranche in a massive debt push fueled by soaring AI infrastructure costs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6249cf93-af39-42b7-921b-26beeea089ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Debt Push** : Alphabet's multi-currency bond sale includes a rare 100-year Sterling bond, marking its sterling market debut and the first tech century bond in nearly 30 years.
* **AI Funding Driver** : The ultra-long debt revival stems from tech giants' huge borrowing needs to finance aggressive AI advancements and related capital expenditures.
* **Investor Appeal** : Primary buyers expected to be UK insurance companies and pension funds, drawn to long-dated Sterling opportunities amid strong demand.
* **Historical Risks Highlighted** : Such bonds carry uncertainties like technological obsolescence or corporate changes, as seen in past cases including J.C. Penney's bankruptcy decades after issuance.

# AI Software rout threatens massive credit market exposure - Morgan Stanley
Fears that advancing AI tools could disrupt the software industry spilled into credit markets Tuesday, with **[Morgan Stanley warning](https://substack.com/redirect/1bbebe88-f05f-4511-a8a2-b4a5eacc638e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that the sector's $235 billion slice of the $1.5 trillion U.S. loan market faces heightened risks from potential defaults and refinancing pressures.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c60913bc-206e-4f42-b587-a6ff73b303ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Credit Exposure Massive:** Software represents 16% or $235 billion of the $1.5 trillion U.S. loan market, exposing lenders to AI-driven disruption risks.
* **Low Ratings Dominate:** Half of software loans carry B- or lower ratings, with 26% at CCC level, **[signaling elevated default potential amid sector worries.](https://substack.com/redirect/a7e25939-0c26-45ff-b5bd-a29a200254cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Maturity Wall Looms:** Roughly 30% of software debt matures by 2028 and 46% within four years, far ahead of the broader market's schedule.
* **Near-Term Outlook Stable:** Morgan Stanley sees limited systemic disruption soon, expecting loan price volatility but no immediate default surge.

# Ferrari stock surges nearly 10% on bullish 2026 outlook
Ferrari shares surged nearly 10% in early New York trading after **[the luxury supercar maker issued upbeat 2026 guidance,](https://substack.com/redirect/c216f829-cbec-48ff-93c3-d5de4959cc32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** projecting revenue growth to €7.5 billion amid sustained strong demand and an order book stretching to late 2027, even as 2025 deliveries dipped slightly during model transitions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c216f829-cbec-48ff-93c3-d5de4959cc32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Solid Demand Persists** : Ferrari's CEO Benedetto Vigna emphasizing disciplined management under the brand's exclusivity model across all markets.
* **Revenue Growth Forecast** : Company guides for ~€7.5 billion in 2026 revenues (up 5% YoY), slightly below analyst consensus of €7.53 billion but signaling continued expansion.
* **Profitability Targets Rise** : Adjusted EBITDA projected at €2.93 billion (up 5.8%), with a 39% margin (up 20 basis points), driven by premium product mix and higher-margin models.
* **Key Drivers Highlighted** : Growth fueled by enhanced personalization via Tailor Made program, new high-end launches, racing revenue boosts from F1 success and sponsorships.

# Saylor shrugs off Bitcoin crash debt doom, plans to refinance "forever"
MicroStrategy CEO Michael Saylor dismissed credit risk concerns Tuesday amid Bitcoin's sharp tumble below $70,000, boldly **[declaring the firm will refinance its $8 billion debt rather than sell holdings](https://substack.com/redirect/55376140-1bac-4299-9832-e4c525540374?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and continue buying the cryptocurrency every quarter indefinitely.
* **Bitcoin holdings surge** : MicroStrategy owns 714,644 bitcoins valued at roughly $49 billion, cementing its position as the largest corporate holder despite recent price volatility.
* **Debt load substantial** : The company carries over $8 billion in total debt, largely from convertible notes issued to fund Bitcoin purchases, with strong cash reserves covering obligations.
* **No selling commitment** : Saylor firmly rejected any notion of liquidating Bitcoin assets, even in extreme scenarios like a 90% drop over four years.
* **Long-term accumulation plan** : Executives emphasized ongoing quarterly Bitcoin buys "forever," viewing volatility as inherent and not a deterrent to the strategy.

# UK PM fights for survival amid Epstein bombshell fallout
UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer **[faces mounting calls to resign from his own Labour Party](https://substack.com/redirect/ca4ee6ec-7b99-4e2e-a987-98b9101c2a3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after newly released Jeffrey Epstein files exposed deeper ties between ex-ambassador Peter Mandelson and the disgraced financier, triggering key staff resignations and a political crisis threatening his government.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca4ee6ec-7b99-4e2e-a987-98b9101c2a3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Mandelson Epstein Links Deepen:** Newly released US Justice Department files reveal post-2008 conviction messages and allegations Mandelson shared market-sensitive government information with Epstein during the financial crisis.
* **Appointment Backlash Escalates:** Starmer appointed Mandelson as US ambassador in 2024 despite known Epstein connections, later firing him in 2025 as more details emerged.
* **Resignations Rock Downing Street:** Starmer's chief of staff and communications director quit amid the scandal, with internal Labour critics including Scottish leader Anas Sarwar demanding the PM step down.
* **Starmer Vows to Remain:** Despite apologies to Epstein's victims for believing Mandelson's "lies," the Prime Minister insists he will not walk away, backed by some Cabinet allies amid market jitters and deep skepticism by British political experts.

SB 1586 would open up 1,700 acres of world-class farmland, by expanding the Metro urban growth boundary into land protected as rural reserves and zoned exclusively for farm use. This land was explicitly safeguarded through a 2014 legislative settlement that every stakeholder agreed to honor known as the grand bargain [https://www.oregonlive.com/politics/2014/03/land_use_grand_bargain_heading.html] . In this exchange, Hillsboro received over 1,000 acres of farmland for industrial use. This bill breaks that promise and opens the door to another speculative land grab. Once this farmland is gone, it’s gone forever. And it’s not needed: Oregon already has thousands of acres of industrial land inside cities, including in Hillsboro.
This bill has not been scheduled for a public hearing yet. Please send your message to your legislators today to stop this Major Threat! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/bZ-sIesX6E--D_ksOxy7VQ2]
Stop this Major Threat [https://secure.ngpvan.com/bZ-sIesX6E--D_ksOxy7VQ2?contactdata=O9JTDwKJSl/qV/zuL7nlkoCtuTSFLDtpU955BlPwHj3h7AXT1j7fG9unu8ekV7JHO2hd8Ya9NsKX9sWIMItc1h9q60hBLngY2zkGuJ9JOPKeEd9/YsrzuvHE7cVCrYlD]
Oregon’s land use system exists because people fought for it. If we don’t speak up now, we risk losing these lands piece by piece.
Together,

# [Why Home and Family are Key to Valentine's Day](https://momsforamerica.us/so/b9Pn8G9-1/c?w=NIlhtabBFLlH-V8ElRPFCm0TU9EKzJGUwdCHhadqv_Y.)

| | Valentine’s Day didn’t begin with flowers or candy - it began with courage, devotion, and a deep commitment to marriage and family. Our culture has reduced love to feelings and fleeting romance, but true love is far richer and more enduring. It is learned first at home, where commitment is lived out in everyday moments of patience, forgiveness, and faith. In a world competing for kids hearts and minds, parents remain the most powerful teachers of authentic love. This Valentine’s Day, let’s reclaim its meaning by celebrating the lasting love that begins in the family and points us back to God. Jon Tester knows that Democrats cannot win here in Montana, even if they are spending millions. He learned that firsthand when he lost to my friend, Tim Sheehy.

Fellow American, Jon Tester has a new game plan now - run an _**"independent"**_ against me.

His hand-picked candidate is a wolf in sheep's clothing. Montana doesn't need a woke, radical left college president - they need someone who will stand up for Montana values and put America FIRST.

_So, what could we expect from this faux-independent?_
1. He would allow biological men to compete against women.
2. He would be another vote to impeach President Trump.
3. He would vote to reopen our border.
4. He would be another reliable vote for Chuck Schumer.

**And that's just the beginning.**

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Bolts: Ohio Bans Grace Periods for Mail Ballots, Fulfilling Trump’s Wishes [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=021026_2&amount=25]
Ohio just made it harder to vote by mail, Team .
Senate Bill 293, which was recently signed into law, repeals Ohio’s practice of counting mail ballots that are postmarked prior to Election Day but that arrive up to four days after polls close. Now, any ballots delayed in the mail that arrive after Election Day won't count in Ohio.
This follows executive orders from President Trump, who is against mail-in voting despite voting that way himself , and has called for ending these so-called grace periods for mail ballots everywhere. Ohio’s new law follows his lead, threatening thousands of votes in the process.
We've said it before and we'll keep saying it: Mail-in balloting is safe and secure. It's a nonpartisan way for eligible voters to make their voices heard in our elections. And now it's harder for them to participate in elections in Ohio, whether they're a military member voting from overseas, someone who is immunocompromised, in a nursing home, or any other reason for voting by mail.
Defending vote-by-mail is a crucial part of protecting our fundamental right to vote. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to support mail-in voting across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=021026_2&amount=35]

Trump has long lied about mail-in voting. He's claimed mail-in voting contributed to his 2020 election loss, though no widespread fraud has been found. In fact, the one case of mail-in ballot fraud in Pennsylvania after the 2020 election was a man who was prosecuted for returning his dead mother's ballot for Trump .
The use of mail-in voting has become very common across the country and study after study has shown that fraud in mail-ballot voting is rare. There are also several safeguards in place nationwide to protect against fraud, including signature requirements and barcodes to track envelopes sent by officials. States have spent tens of millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing.
In Ohio, this new law will result in thousands of ballots being thrown out. We know this because thousands of ballots were accepted in the grace period in previous selections, some of them making the difference in local elections -- like in Warren County, where several races came down to single-digit margins.
Being blunt: There is no good-faith reason to end the vote-by-mail grace period. Just like the other Trump attacks on our elections in general and mail-in voting in particular -- this is a partisan voter suppression exercise meant to codify MAGA's power in perpetuity.
Opponents of voting rights will go to any length necessary to stay in power. Pitch in $35 or whatever you can to protect mail-in voting nationwide and stop these suppressive policies >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=021026_2&amount=35]

## Turning the tide of the culture war...
For the last 10 years or so there's been a lot of talk about the so-called culture war.
Right vs left, conservative vs liberal, everyone is trying to influence popular culture.
And for the most part, the left has been winning, with their control over the mainstream media, Hollywood, and music.
But warring halftime shows this Super Bowl show that that trend is changing.
Americans had a choice:
Watch the regularly scheduled halftime show, with Bad Bunny performing in Spanish and dancing with scantily clad women, or tune in to the TPUSA alternative, with Kid Rock, Lee Brice, and Gabby Barrett, among others.
Numbers are still coming in, but with what we know so far, Americans sent a clear message with their viewing choice.
Let's break it down...

| | **The Trump Administration's brutal occupation of American communities with armed, masked agents must end immediately.** Congress has a responsibility to defend the American people from this lawlessness. Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle must unite in this effort and assert our constitutionally mandated congressional oversight authority to hold the Administration accountable. We must stop this violence before more lives are lost. That is why I voted no on a bill funding the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and I am demanding more accountability and oversight of DHS operations. I support impeaching DHS Secretary Noem and negotiating a full-year funding bill for DHS that creates accountability and oversight of ICE operations and DHS detention facilities, including provisions to:
* Ensure ICE and CBP immediately leave Minneapolis and stop terrorizing American cities and communities
* Ensure full, independent, and transparent investigations into all DHS-related shootings, including federal cooperation with state and local investigations, and ensure that federal agents are properly trained, appropriately supervised, and held fully accountable for their actions
* Ensure robust minimum standards of care at detention facilities – including access to medical care, clean water, edible food, and protections against abuse – and ensure independent investigations of deaths
* End arrests without judicial warrants and, outside of exigent circumstances, arrests at sensitive locations such as churches, shelters, schools, and courthouses
* End the detention and deportation of U.S. citizens
* End the anonymity of federal agents by requiring them to remove their masks and provide identification

clean_body: The Trump Administration’s brutal occupation of American communities with armed, masked agents must end immediately. | | | | The Trump Administration's brutal occupation of American communities with armed, masked agents must end immediately. Congress has a responsibility to defend the American people from this lawlessness. Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle must unite in this effort and assert our constitutionally mandated congressional oversight authority to hold the Administration accountable. We must stop this violence before more lives are lost. That is why I voted no on a bill funding the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and I am demanding more accountability and oversight of DHS operations. I support impeaching DHS Secretary Noem and negotiating a full-year funding bill for DHS that creates accountability and oversight of ICE operations and DHS detention facilities, including provisions to: Ensure ICE and CBP immediately leave Minneapolis and stop terrorizing American cities and communities Ensure full, independent, and transparent investigations into all DHS-related shootings, including federal cooperation with state and local investigations, and ensure that federal agents are properly trained, appropriately supervised, and held fully accountable for their actions Ensure robust minimum standards of care at detention facilities – including access to medical care, clean water, edible food, and protections against abuse – and ensure independent investigations of deaths End arrests without judicial warrants and, outside of exigent circumstances, arrests at sensitive locations such as churches, shelters, schools, and courthouses End the detention and deportation of U.S. citizens End the anonymity of federal agents by requiring them to remove their masks and provide identification More soon, Rick | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution to Rick Larsen instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | Paid for and authorized by Citizens to Elect Rick Larsen. | This email was sent by . subject: The Mountain Minute: 2/10/2026
body:
Democrat Gov Jared Polis Sees Opportunity in Federal School of Choice Funds
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
In partnership with Southwest Republican Women and the La Plata County Republican Central Committee, RMV is bringing Republican candidates directly to voters at a **[Colorado Republican Candidate Forum](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** in **Durango** on **Feb. 13** —**opening the floor to Coloradans statewide to submit questions ahead of time.**
👉 **Submit your question[here](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers advanced proposals critics say expand state control and raise costs, from [backing pediatric vaccine guidance](https://link.email.joinrmv.) that reignited parental-rights debates to legislation imposing new price controls—[mocked by Rep. Ken DeGraaf](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as setting a “county average for pretzels.” Meanwhile, [HB26-1065 is drawing resistance](https://link.email.joinrmv.) over concerns it shifts power to unelected bodies, weakens local control, and diverts tax revenue amid mounting budget pressure.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Public safety and politics collided as two men received lengthy sentences for a [fentanyl overdose](https://link.email.joinrmv.) that killed a 16-year-old, highlighting the toll of the drug crisis. Gov. Jared Polis declared that “in Colorado, [we trust the parents](https://link.email.joinrmv.)” while embracing Trump-era “free money” for school choice. Greeley voters are also heading into [a special election](https://link.email.joinrmv.) on major development plans, and GOP candidates will meet in Durango for a voter-driven forum, with Coloradans invited to submit questions statewide.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** New FBI memos show federal officials quietly prepared for a disputed 2020 election and potential violence [months before Election Day](https://link.email.joinrmv.), raising fresh questions about what was known, what was disclosed, and whether those assessments later justified expanded surveillance and prosecutions.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** This week’s commentary warns that protest is increasingly being used to excuse lawlessness, arguing that when institutions rationalize illegal conduct for favored causes, [they erode the rule of law](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and replace equal enforcement with ideological double standards.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, February 10, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Democrat Gov Jared Polis Sees Opportunity in Federal School of Choice Funds](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [THE 74](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
"In Colorado, we trust the parents," Governor Jared Polis. The school choice proponent — and possible 2028 contender — is one of just two Democratic governors opting into a new federal scholarship tax credit. Colorado Gov. Jared Polis may be the Democratic Party’s single most prominent supporter of school choice.
In his life before politics, he co-founded two charter schools in his home state. During his time serving in the U.S. House of Representatives, he authored bipartisan legislation to expand high-performing charters, citing hundreds of thousands of families on waitlists nationwide. And now, in his last year as Colorado’s chief executive, he has even signed on to participate in the Trump administration’s biggest K–12 policy initiative to date: a tax credit designed to expand school choice across the country.
The benefit, which will come online next January, allows donors to save up to $1,700 on their federal taxes by contributing to organizations that defray students’ educational costs, including private school tuition. Taxpayers from anywhere in the U.S. can give freely and claim the credit, but individual states must opt in for their students to receive the scholarships. To this point, 26 Republican governors have said they will take steps to do so; only Polis and one other Democrat, North Carolina’s Josh Stein, have done the same.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[A ‘county average’ for pretzels: Colorado’s next price-control creep](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY REP. KEN DEGRAAF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Bill would impose de facto price controls under the guise of “fairness” —** HB26-1012 presumes a business is engaging in unfair practices if prices exceed an undefined “county average,” effectively letting the state decide what vendors can charge for optional goods like food, drinks, or parking at events.
* **Rep. Ken DeGraaf warns of “price-control creep” and regulatory chaos** — DeGraaf argues the bill amounts to government setting a “county average for pretzels,” forcing small vendors to guess at compliance standards and exposing them to lawsuits, treble damages, and bureaucratic enforcement.
* **Critics say the bill will raise costs and drive vendors out** — The commentary warns that artificial pricing benchmarks distort supply and demand, increase compliance costs, discourage small operators from participating in fairs and events, and ultimately leave consumers with fewer choices and higher prices.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
