The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Durango forum brings together Republican candidates ahead of caucus and assembly season](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Republican candidates head to Durango ahead of caucus and assembly season** — The Feb. 13 forum brings together GOP candidates for statewide offices, U.S. Senate, and governor, giving Southwest Colorado voters direct access without campaign theatrics.
* **Issue-focused panels replace soundbites and sparring** — The event is structured around moderated panels with timed answers, keeping the focus on policy positions rather than personality-driven debates.
* **Voters statewide are invited into the process** — RMV and local GOP partners are accepting question submissions in advance, with selected questions asked live so candidates address real voter concerns.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[**Open letter warns HB26-1065 expands unelected power and state control**](https://link.email.joinrmv.) **BY CORY GAINES | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 9** ___In keeping with earlier posts, I have been watching affordable housing legislation this session. One of the bills that came up in an earlier post is HB26-1065. I link to that bill first below. Mild in the impact, especially compared with efforts that take away local control and further reinforce the NGO/nonprofit/government complex, this bill is still concerning in what it sets up._ __
[**No Man’s Land: Surrendering Self at the Cross**](https://link.email.joinrmv.) **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 8** _In response to concerns raised by a family in Colorado about the treatment of their young son in kindergarten, the Office for Civil Rights of the U.S. Department of Education opened an investigation into whether the Cherry Creek School District was in compliance with federal civil rights and special education law, a problem that is not new to the district._
[**Phil Weiser’s ICE portal: A hotline for the wrong crisis**](https://link.email.joinrmv.) **BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 6** ___Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser wants you to do something._ _Not vote. Not volunteer. Not show up to a school board meeting and read the agenda before somebody else reads it for you. He wants you to report ICE._ __

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|
---
|
---
⏳ **DID YOU KNOW?** Colorado has seen “government control creep” before. **During the 1903–1904 Colorado Labor Wars** , the governor declared an “insurrection,” imposed martial law, suspended habeas corpus, and used the National Guard to deport union members without trial—sparking public outrage that later helped push Colorado to adopt one of the nation’s earliest direct primary laws so voters, not political power brokers, could choose candidates.
|
---
**CARTOON OF THE DAY**
|
---
**QUOTE OF THE DAY** “Price controls almost invariably produce black markets, where prices are not only higher than the legally permitted prices, but also higher than they would be in a free market, since the legal risks must also be compensated.” – Thomas Sowell

And with only a little over a month until election day, MAGA billionaires are scrambling to claim it from Democrats, not with a Republican, but by funding and supporting the campaigns of their chosen "Democrat" candidates via AIPAC. Just a few days ago, AIPAC attempted a coup in NJ-11's district. But it blew up in their faces when progressive Analila Mejia pulled off a stunning upset. AIPAC got involved in the race on behalf of their chosen candidate to attack a Democrat who they wrongly believed to be the favorite, allowing Analia to surge right past them both. | == But in IL-9, MAGA has already learned from their mistakes. Groups connected to AIPAC are supporting two Democrats that are considered frontrunners. AIPAC Super PAC "Elect Chicago Women" is spending hundreds of thousands supporting Laura Fine and AIPAC affiliated 314 Action has spent hundreds of thousands supporting Daniel Biss. As these two candidates attack each other's campaigns, MAGA is banking on a head-to-head between them, with Democrats none the wiser and MAGA coming out on top no matter who wins. | == But Democrats have a chance to shock AIPAC again by supporting progressive Bushra Amiwala. Bushra Amiwala is the only progressive Democrat with a chance to win this election and prevent MAGA from seizing this seat. clean_body: = It's Governor JB Pritzker. I’m emailing you today about New Hampshire’s Senate race because this is serious: Senate Republicans’ hand-picked candidate, John Sununu, jumped in to defeat Chris Pappas and flip this open Senate seat red. = Without Chris Pappas winning in New Hampshire, Democrats won’t have a chance at taking back a majority in the Senate. That’s why this race is being targeted by GOP super PACs and Republicans across the country. The NRSC — which pours millions into electing Republicans to the Senate — said they’re “all-in” on John Sununu. And polling shows: This race is a statistical dead heat between Chris Pappas and John Sununu. This means New Hampshire will see historic levels of outside spending, and we have to be ready to fight back. Chris is a proven fighter for working families — and he’s seen tough campaigns like this before. He knows it takes grassroots support to win a race like this. clean_body: This is huge — but our job isn't over yet. | | | Quick update, Peter: WFP's Analilia Mejia just declared victory in her primary for Congress in NJ-11! Analilia's historic win is a victory for working people that heralds a new day in New Jersey politics, and has the potential to resonate across the country. But our job is far from finished. **The general special election in NJ-11 is just a few weeks away in April. And after that, Analilia will need to run in the regularly scheduled primary for the same seat in June. All of this means more doors to knock, more voters to reach... and more resources to raise. Corporate donors may try and spend millions over the next few months to try and wrestle this seat away from working people. But we've already proven we don't need to match them dollar-for-dollar in order to win with candidates like Analilia — we only need enough to make sure our voices are heard. In solidarity, Working Families Party \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: WFP Election Alert Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 Subject: A political shockwave in New Jersey Peter, With over 90% of the vote counted, last night’s special primary in New Jersey’s 11th district is setting off a political shockwave : Analilia Mejia — a Working Families Party leader — is winning in the special election for New Jersey’s 11th Congressional District! This wasn’t just a referendum on the issues that voters want Congress to address. It was also a warning shot to the entire political establishment. Analilia’s performance yesterday was historic. She shocked the New Jersey political establishment, and did what so many people said she couldn’t. Working people in New Jersey and across the country are sick and tired of the status quo and hungry**for real leadership — and Analilia's performance was proof of that. She ran on standing up for workers’ rights, economic justice, and a democracy that belongs to everyday people, not corporate interests. Those are issues that are resonating across the entire country. Now, our mission is to keep this energy going. ** The Working Families Party has been a force in New Jersey for years. We’ve notched some big wins in the Garden State, helping to overturn the corrupt “county line” ballot design system and electing a number of champions in just the past few years. This is one of our biggest wins yet. And it’s only the beginning of what could be an even bigger year for our movement, not just in Jersey but across the country. There’s a reason the other side works so hard to discredit our work and our champions. The billionaire class knows that the biggest threat to their power is a unified, multi-racial working-class movement like the one we’re building with candidates like Analilia and other Working Families Party champions. | | , Representative Gene Wu is a friend of mine. He’s a civil rights lawyer, a devoted husband, a proud father, and an American in every sense of the word. Gene was the heart, face, and voice of Texas House Democrats when they risked everything and walked out to stop Trump and Abbott’s racist gerrymander. They did it on our behalf. That act of constitutional defiance was not only appropriate, it was productive. It electrified a national conversation about redistricting and inspired leaders in other states to take action of their own. **That’s what leadership looks like.** Gene endorsed my campaign for Texas Attorney General early on, and I am proud of that endorsement. You’ll see it on our early voting literature, because it represents the best of what Texas Democrats stand for. **Now MAGA Republicans are responding the only way they know how. They are demanding that Gene’s citizenship be revoked. Denaturalized. Stripped away.** This kind of rhetoric is ignorant, un-American, and deeply dangerous. It is the same politics of fear and exclusion that targets Muslims, immigrants, and anyone MAGA decides does not belong. They prey on people because cruelty excites their base. Part of living in a free society is enduring ignorant voices who confuse hate with power. It’s a burden, but it’s one we carry because we believe in the Bill of Rights and the freedoms it protects. What’s truly alarming is that these MAGA candidates believe government exists to enforce their grievances, as if there were some elite court empowered to banish people they dislike. Their fantasy is authoritarian, and it has no place in America. Texas Democrats running for office represent the America we all know and love. An America rooted in law, dignity, and equal justice. MAGA represents a political cult, blindly following a handful of authoritarian figures over a cliff. America isn’t going with them. Those of us who understand freedom are staying right here, feet planted firmly on free soil, and we are going to fight for this country together. [**If you are with me, please consider contributing to my campaign to take back the Office of Attorney General. Let's stand together.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=837b227930&e=5d8d80652b) Onward!

**

name: Ted Cruz
subject: A personal plea to my fellow Christians:
body:
Will you read this short passage with me?
Remember those who are persecuted for their faith.
| Friend, This message may be a bit different from what you’re used to, but frankly, it’s quite personal and important. I'd like you to read this passage with me from Hebrews 13:3: _“Continue to remember those in prison as if you were together with them in prison, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.”_ **As a follower of Christ, nothing weighs heavier on my heart than the suffering of our brothers and sisters who are paying the ultimate price for their faith.** I've seen the reports, heard the stories personally, and fought in the U.S. Senate to shine a light on this darkness because their pain is real, raw, and relentless. They aren't distant statistics – _they're our family in Christ._ _Since 2009 in Nigeria, it's estimated that**over 100,000 Christians have been massacred, 20,000 churches have been destroyed** , and **over 5 million have been displaced.** _ _In China, it is not uncommon for faithful believers to be**arrested simply for gathering to worship** , to have their **homes raided** , and their **leaders imprisoned**. _ _In Sudan, Islamist paramilitaries have long been on a rampage –**bombing churches** and **killing priests and worshippers** , forcing survivors to **convert or be killed**. _ **Christians are the most persecuted religious group on the planet. At least 380 million endure heavy persecution – many of them children.** My faith demands I act, and I’d like to personally – _and urgently_ – ask you to do the same. **Save The Persecuted Christians is a vital non-profit organization working on the front lines to raise awareness, brief lawmakers, and push for real accountability.** **[ They are saving lives and saving souls. name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: “Nationalizing” elections
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOCELYN BENSON FOR GOVERNOR]
body:
[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Our elections are safe, secure, and transparent.

So when Donald Trump talks about “nationalizing” elections, it’s important
to understand what’s really happening. This isn’t about fixing a system
that’s broken. It’s about weakening people’s faith in democracy so fewer
voices are heard. I’ve seen this strategy before.

When politicians spread lies about elections, the goal is not just to
challenge results. It’s to make people feel discouraged, afraid, or
convinced that participating doesn’t matter. Over time, that kind of fear
and confusion erodes democracy from the inside out.

As Michigan’s Secretary of State, I’ve had a front-row seat to these
attacks. I’ve seen how misinformation puts pressure on election workers,
targets public servants, and tries to bully communities into silence.

And I’ve learned something else just as important. The antidote to fear is
showing up. The antidote to lies is transparency. And the antidote to
attempts to grab power is a people-driven movement that refuses to back
down.

That’s why I’m running for governor.

I believe democracy only works when we protect it, practice it, and defend
the people who make it possible. I will always stand up for voters and for
elections that belong to the people, not politicians chasing control.

clean_body: We must fight back to ensure that the will of the people prevails in November. | Peter, Republicans aren’t just manipulating maps to grab power — they’re trying to eliminate redistricting reform altogether. This is what’s happening in Utah, where Donald Trump has endorsed the state Republican Party’s efforts to dismantle the current system that requires congressional maps be drawn by a bipartisan commission. Republicans have been against the initiative, known as Proposition 4, since it was passed by voters in 2018. And now that a new, fairer map indicates that a Democrat might be able to win a district, they're even more desperate to repeal it. = This situation in Utah is just one part of a coordinated attack on democracy. Several Republican states redrew their maps mid-decade to give Republicans an unfair advantage in the midterms. Meanwhile, Republicans in Congress are currently trying hard to pass the SAVE Act and similar legislation that would make it harder for millions of Americans to vote. Here’s the thing: What they’re trying to do isn’t just wrong — it’s unpopular, too. Just like other Republican-led attempts to manipulate maps across the country, the effort to repeal Proposition 4 is supported by just 26% of Utahns. It’s no wonder the campaign to get it on the ballot is struggling to reach the required number of petition signatures before the deadline this Saturday. So Republicans are scrambling. President Trump himself has taken to social media to beg Utah voters to sign the petition. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

| Peter,

I just wanted to check in. The past few weeks have been heavy. After watching ICE agents kill innocent civilians and then smear the victims, I know a lot of people are shaken. I am too.

This is not normal. And it should never be accepted as the cost of living in this country.

**There is a rot in ICE that cannot be repaired under Donald Trump and Kristi Noem.**

To restore public trust, ICE must be dismantled and replaced by an interior agency with more rigorous training and standards, increased oversight and accountability, and safer outcomes for all.

In the meantime, I want you to know this: **I will not stand by as masked vigilantes unjustly target immigrant and refugee communities.**

That’s why I worked with my colleagues to introduce legislation to require ICE agents to identify themselves and abide by due process. It’s why I speak out when power is abused.

And it’s why I’m running for Congress. Because silence is not an option.

Please take care of yourself. Please stay safe out there. And thank you for standing with me.

With gratitude,

Most Tennesseans are shocked when they discover this: even on your own property, many utilities insist you use "their" chosen contractors to install critical infrastructure--sometimes at inflated prices, on their schedule, and with little transparency. You pay the bill, but you don't get a real say.
Tennessee House Bill 0796 changes that. It's a simple, common-sense reform: it lets utility customers choose their own qualified contractors to install utility infrastructure on their property, while still allowing utilities to set reasonable standards to protect safety and system reliability.
In plain terms, if you're building a new home, expanding a business, or upgrading service to a farm, HB 0796 means you won't be locked into a monopoly installer chosen by the utility. You can seek competitive bids, choose who you trust, and manage your own project timeline--just like you already do with electricians, plumbers, roofers, and builders.
Utilities retain the authority they actually need: they can establish reasonable specifications for the work. That means they can still require that lines, meters, pipes, and other infrastructure meet technical standards, be safely installed, and be compatible with their systems. The bill does *not* let just anyone slap a line in the ground however they please. It simply separates "who does the work" from "what standards the work must meet."
That distinction matters for liberty and for your wallet.
When a utility can dictate both the standards and the contractor, customers effectively lose all leverage. Imagine if your local building inspector could also force you to hire his preferred construction company. Costs would climb, service would lag, and quality might suffer because there's no competitive pressure. Utility-directed contracting works much the same way.
By opening the door to competition, HB 796 encourages lower prices and better service. A small business owner trying to connect a new workshop can shop around instead of accepting a single, take-it-or-leave-it quote. A young family building a first home can work with a contractor they already trust, coordinating utility installation with the rest of the construction, instead of waiting weeks for a slot on the utility's schedule. A farmer extending service to a barn can hire a local crew that understands the land and the layout.
This is, at its core, a property rights issue. If infrastructure is being installed on your land, you should have a meaningful say in who performs that work. HB 0796 respects that basic principle, without sacrificing the safety and reliability that all Tennesseans depend on.
It's also a limited-government reform. Public utilities already exercise enormous power as government-granted monopolies over essential services. Allowing them to control not just the service, but also who gets hired to install infrastructure on private property, extends that monopoly too far. HB 796 draws an appropriate line: utilities set the rules of the road; customers choose who drives the car.
Lawmakers should pass HB 796, and Tennesseans should urge them to do so. Contact your state representative and senator, and tell them you support restoring choice, competition, and property rights in our utility system. It's your land, your money, and your infrastructure. You deserve the freedom to choose.

clean_body: ARE YOU STILL A REPUBLICAN? I just finished reviewing your previous survey submissions from 2025, and I have to say -- you really stood out. Your answers were always SPOT ON. That's why we're opening the Republican Voter Sentiment Survey - to hear directly from grassroots leaders like YOU. ARE YOU STILL A REPUBLICAN? | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. I’m writing to tell you about a leader who truly inspires me: Jena Griswold. = Jena has shown courageous leadership as Colorado's current Secretary of State — refusing to be intimidated by death threats as she oversaw the last presidential election and protected free and fair elections in her state. She understands that we can’t fight the climate crisis without a functioning democracy. That type of leadership and unwavering backbone are why JanePAC endorses her as Colorado’s next Attorney General. = Jena has lived the climate crisis firsthand. She grew up in rural Colorado, and in 2021, she watched much of her community in Louisville burn during a devastating winter wildfire. Today, Colorado faces worsening fires, deepening drought, and rising temperatures that threaten families, local businesses, and the beautiful outdoors we all love. What sets Jena apart is that she knows real climate action depends on something deeper: protecting our democracy and holding power accountable. As Secretary of State, Jena publicly opposed Trump's rollback of environmental regulations and pushed for legislation to fight disinformation and curb corporate money in politics. As Attorney General, Jena will hold corporate polluters accountable, enforce Colorado’s laws on reducing carbon emissions, and oppose fossil fuel expansion to advance the state’s transition to 100% clean energy. clean_body: The only thing more powerful than hate is love! | | | Hey Peter, Did you catch the words on the big screen during Bad Bunny’s performance on Sunday night? 🗣️ “The only thing more powerful than hate is love.” We know this is true because we see it everyday in our communities. Despite ICE unleashing all-out terror in our cities, our neighbors continue showing up daily to care for each other. We’ve seen it in Minnesota, where below-freezing temperatures don’t stop our neighbors from gathering in mass community-organized protests. We see it everyday in our hospitals and schools, where thousands of DACA recipients use their knowledge and skills to care for our loved ones. In the face of fear and uncertainty, we’re choosing community, solidarity, and collective power. ✊🧡 👉There’s still time for you to show up with care and love for your neighbors in detention! Sign up to our letter-writing gathering and deliver notes of solidarity to our neighbors when they need it most. In a moment where our neighbors are being held in detention hundreds of miles away from their loved ones, a note of solidarity can make them feel closer to home and remind them that our community has their back. At our letter writing gathering on Thursday, we’ll: 🫂 Make meaning of this moment together ✍️ Write letters of encouragement and solidarity to our neighbors in detention 🧡 Learn how to bring our friends and family together to write more letters Will you invite your loved ones to grab their pen and paper, and join you at our “Powered by Love, Not Cages” Community Call on Thursday? ** See you there, Ximena and the UWD team | Follow us on: | | | | |

Dan Meuser is back from Mexico and he's on clean-up duty.
While the rest of us were freezing in PA and raising concerns about the two massive ICE facilities coming here, Meuser was working on his tan. He came back from vacation to thousands of angry constituents who have questions he still won't answer.
For weeks, residents spoke out about the detention centers that will **cost taxpayers more than $1 million, overwhelm public resources in small rural communities, and bring the chaos we 've seen in other parts of the country into our backyards.** And Meuser said nothing and did nothing. But now that he's facing backlash, he says he has "serious concerns."
If he really cared, he would have been listening before the deal was done. He would have stood up for his constituents instead of jetting off to Mexico. He would have been doing his job.
Even now, **he still isn 't trying to stop these facilities from being built.** He's just continuing to tell us to work with them.
Meuser forgets about us until the headlines are bad. We shouldn't have to beg to be heard by our representative. Our interests should be fought for.

When most people think about leaving something behind for their kids or grandkids, they default to **cash, stocks, or real estate.**

The problem?

Every one of those inheritances **leaves a paper trail.** Bank accounts are reported. Brokerage statements are tracked. Real estate transfers require government paperwork.

**The IRS loves it. Easy to track, easy to tax.**

But there's one inheritance asset that works differently: **physical gold.**

Unlike stocks or cash in the bank, **gold coins don't generate automatic IRS forms.**

When you buy popular coins like American Gold Eagles and store them at home or in a private vault, they sit outside the banking system.

That's why many families are turning to gold. It's private, durable, and completely under your control.

What most people don't realize is that you don't need a separate stash of cash to do it.

You can use the retirement savings you already have — in a **401(k), IRA, or TSP** — to buy real gold coins and bars.

And if you're 591⁄2 or older, **this purchase is completely tax-deferred and penalty-free.**

Once you retire, you even have the option to take delivery of those metals right to your home.

That means passing wealth to your heirs can be as simple as handing it to them directly. **No middlemen, no forms, no red tape.**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | First Invеstmеnt Updаtеs brоught tо уоu bу Іnception Media, LLC. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2602-q1-jg-doj?refcode=260210-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2602-q1-jg-doj?refcode=260210-email]
Peter –
I wanted to reach out to you directly about something serious, and to explain why I recorded a video addressing it.
In December, the U.S. Department of Justice sued me for refusing to hand over Colorado’s voter registration data, including highly sensitive personal information like driver’s license numbers and the last four digits of Social Security numbers.
I joined Secretaries of State from across the country to ask the DOJ a simple question: Why is the federal government trying to collect massive amounts of private voter data? Instead of answering, they sued.
At a time when this administration is spreading election misinformation and ICE raids are targeting communities across the country, I will not hand over confidential voter information when Trump’s DOJ has no legal right to it. Protecting Coloradans’ personal information is not optional — it’s my responsibility.

Hi there,

My name is Paul, and I’m running for Congress in IL-16 to oust Darin LaHood.

I’m a hometown kid: I was born right here in Rockford, graduated from public high school and Illinois State University, and now I’m raising my kids in the same community I grew up in.

I’m running for Congress because my working-class parents taught me the value of showing up, working hard, and doing right by your neighbors – values that I think Darin LaHood is severely lacking.

I’ve seen the damage done by failed policies from both parties: factories shuttered, family farms sold off, small businesses squeezed, and young people leaving their hometowns behind because there aren't enough opportunities.

It doesn’t have to be this way. I believe in an America where work is rewarded, not exploited. Where we expand modern American manufacturing and rebuild our communities with good-paying, family-sustaining careers. An America where veterans are not forgotten, corruption is rooted out, small business thrives, family farmers succeed, and unions are respected.

[**But I need your help to get to Congress and fight for that America. I’m not a millionaire, and I don’t accept big-money corporate PAC checks – I rely on grassroots power. clean_body: = Hi there, My name is Paul, and I’m running for Congress in IL-16 to oust Darin LaHood. I’m a hometown kid: I was born right here in Rockford, graduated from public high school and Illinois State University, and now I’m raising my kids in the same community I grew up in. I’m running for Congress because my working-class parents taught me the value of showing up, working hard, and doing right by your neighbors – values that I think Darin LaHood is severely lacking. I’ve seen the damage done by failed policies from both parties: factories shuttered, family farms sold off, small businesses squeezed, and young people leaving their hometowns behind because there aren't enough opportunities. It doesn’t have to be this way. I believe in an America where work is rewarded, not exploited. Where we expand modern American manufacturing and rebuild our communities with good-paying, family-sustaining careers. | | Fellow Patriot,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

name: John Padora For Colorado
subject: We can’t keep doing politics this way
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Padora for Colorado
body:
The Constitution is under attack, families are struggling, and politics as usual is failing us. I’m choosing a different path.

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/BbTfJgrAJBPYSWSHcNHI3g~~/AAUS1hA~/l-FTJv7Wq0odsPMU9R7c_afo4gHLwblUQMWBfUNutcf6eApEvv3lWS4u128MbwLnQU58mrRysfsoBN-4CfviAEqtEl_gR-9Z_qif-ZzoXgzdLK75tVGOwt6y8nGxji6T)
| | **Friend,** **Let me ask you something honestly.** How often lately have you turned off the news because it just feels overwhelming? Every day it’s something new.
Another abuse of power.
Another headline that makes this country feel more unrecognizable.
Another reminder that **the rules no longer apply equally**. We are watching **our Constitution trampled in real time**.
Checks and balances ignored.
Accountability stripped away.
Truth buried under money, influence, and political convenience. And now, with the release of the Epstein files, many people are being forced to confront something deeply uncomfortable. **A lot of Americans who were dismissed for questioning power were right.** Not because they were chasing conspiracies.
But because **when wealth and power concentrate, secrecy, corruption, and abuse follow**. That realization is exhausting.
It makes people angry.
It makes people want to tune out. **You’re not crazy for feeling this way.** At the same time, millions of families are barely holding on. **Groceries cost more. Rent costs more. Healthcare costs more.**
Paychecks do not stretch. Savings disappear.
Parents skip meals so their kids do not have to.
People work harder than ever and still fall further behind. This is not a personal failure.
**It is a systemic one.** And here is the hard truth too many people in Washington refuse to face. **Democratic Party leadership is out of touch with where most Americans actually are.**
Out of touch with working people.
Out of touch with independents.
Out of touch even with their own base. Instead, we get candidates pulling in **millions of dollars from wealthy donors** , hiring **DC pipeline consultants** , and surrounding themselves with people who have never had to worry about rent, groceries, or medical bills. When everything revolves around money, reality disappears. That is why you get **fundraising emails every single day** , sometimes multiple times a day, treating you like a personal ATM instead of a human being. And then they wonder why people feel alienated.
Why turnout drops.
Why voters stop believing anything will ever change. **We cannot keep doing things the same way and expect different results.** That is why I am running for Congress differently. I am a manufacturing engineer.
A working dad.
Someone who knows the pressure of trying to hold it all together in an economy that no longer works for the people who keep it running. I am not building a campaign fueled by corporate cash or wealthy donor pipelines.
I am choosing a **fully grassroots approach**. People giving **whatever they can afford**.
A **massive volunteer-powered movement**.
Neighbors talking to neighbors.
Real conversations, not consultant-tested talking points. Because **this country does not change when powerful people grow a conscience**.
It changes when ordinary people decide they have had enough. Hope does not mean pretending everything is fine.
Hope means choosing to fight for something better anyway. If you are able, I am asking you to chip in today. Your contribution helps us **pay and feed staff, reach voters by door and mail, film our next ad, open a small campaign HQ, and build the grassroots army it takes to actually win**. clean_body: The Constitution is under attack, families are struggling, and politics as usual is failing us. I’m choosing a different path. | | | Friend, Let me ask you something honestly. How often lately have you turned off the news because it just feels overwhelming? Every day it’s something new. Another abuse of power. Another headline that makes this country feel more unrecognizable. Another reminder that the rules no longer apply equally. We are watching our Constitution trampled in real time. Checks and balances ignored. Accountability stripped away. Truth buried under money, influence, and political convenience. And now, with the release of the Epstein files, many people are being forced to confront something deeply uncomfortable. A lot of Americans who were dismissed for questioning power were right. Not because they were chasing conspiracies. But because when wealth and power concentrate, secrecy, corruption, and abuse follow. That realization is exhausting. It makes people angry. It makes people want to tune out. You’re not crazy for feeling this way. At the same time, millions of families are barely holding on. Groceries cost more. Rent costs more. Healthcare costs more. Paychecks do not stretch. Savings disappear. Parents skip meals so their kids do not have to. People work harder than ever and still fall further behind. This is not a personal failure. It is a systemic one. And here is the hard truth too many people in Washington refuse to face. Democratic Party leadership is out of touch with where most Americans actually are. Out of touch with working people. Out of touch with independents. Out of touch even with their own base. Instead, we get candidates pulling in millions of dollars from wealthy donors , hiring DC pipeline consultants , and surrounding themselves with people who have never had to worry about rent, groceries, or medical bills. When everything revolves around money, reality disappears. That is why you get fundraising emails every single day , sometimes multiple times a day, treating you like a personal ATM instead of a human being. And then they wonder why people feel alienated. Why turnout drops. Why voters stop believing anything will ever change. We cannot keep doing things the same way and expect different results. That is why I am running for Congress differently. I am a manufacturing engineer. A working dad. Someone who knows the pressure of trying to hold it all together in an economy that no longer works for the people who keep it running. I am not building a campaign fueled by corporate cash or wealthy donor pipelines. I am choosing a fully grassroots approach. People giving whatever they can afford. A massive volunteer-powered movement. Neighbors talking to neighbors. Real conversations, not consultant-tested talking points. Because this country does not change when powerful people grow a conscience. It changes when ordinary people decide they have had enough. Hope does not mean pretending everything is fine. Hope means choosing to fight for something better anyway. If you are able, I am asking you to chip in today. Your contribution helps us pay and feed staff, reach voters by door and mail, film our next ad, open a small campaign HQ, and build the grassroots army it takes to actually win. This campaign exists because people like you refuse to accept that this is as good as it gets. We are not powerless. We are not alone. subject: In case you missed it.......
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
Join Team Karen for the KC for JOCO Volunteer Kickoff!

| | | | | |
---
| |
Hi Peter,I’m excited to invite you to our Volunteer Kickoff on **Wednesday, February 11 at 7PM** as we officially launch the 2026 primary!
---
| | | | |
---
| [RSVP TODAY!](https://us.list-manage.com/2wD25zpG2XG?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494)
---
| | I’m running because just identifying problems isn’t enough, Johnson County needs leadership with priorities and a plan. In just five years, the county budget has grown by 45%, from $1.26 billion to $1.83 billion. Families feel that growth every month in their property tax bills, and still our commission is deaf to concerns and are raising spending year after year.As Commission Chair, I will fight to cut property taxes, rein in runaway spending, and restore fiscal sanity. COVID-era funding was meant to be temporary, but it created permanent obligations. I will work to eliminate waste, reduce non-essential spending, and make sure every tax dollar is spent wisely.I also believe Johnson County must remain family-friendly. That means expanding pathways to single-family homeownership, protecting neighborhoods, and pushing back against policies that favor out-of-state corporations over local families.**Our Volunteer Kickoff is your chance to meet the team, learn what we’re building, and find the role that fits you best. Whether you have a few minutes a week or more time to give, you can make a real difference.** This campaign is powered by neighbors like you who care about the future of Johnson County. I hope you’ll join us on **February 11 at 7PM**.Thank you,
Karen Crnkovich
Candidate for Johnson County Commission

---

name: Rep. Ilhan Omar
subject: In my neighborhood
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2079%2E791427%2EbD97j1)
Friend, MAGA is trying to turn our attention away from ICE’s indefensible occupation of Minnesota, but the daily incidents of injustice and indecency in my neighborhood, my city, and my state continue.
Alberto Castañeda Mondragón, a **legal** immigrant, was pulled from his car in St. Paul by ICE agents, thrown to the ground, handcuffed, and beaten repeatedly in the head with a steel baton. Once detained, they beat him more. They attacked Alberto so violently that he initially couldn’t remember he had a daughter, and still suffers from major memory loss.
The ICE agents involved claimed he ran headfirst into a brick wall. This disgusting lie was easily disproven by medical exams and the doctors and nurses who gave him emergency care. Days later, it was revealed that the arrest was completely unlawful in the first place:
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4888?t=2&akid=2079%2E791427%2EbD97j1)
Javier Abreu-Vasquez, who also entered the US legally, was disappeared by ICE in Rochester, Minnesota while delivering groceries as part of a community aid effort through his church. Witnesses said his car “was rammed and a window was broken” when he was detained.
Javier, a recent recipient of a kidney transplant, was denied his life-saving kidney medication for **four days** while in ICE custody, despite his pleas for help from his family, his attorney, and local officials. It’s a miracle Javier is still alive right now, and I pray for his health now that he has access to his medication.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4889?t=3&akid=2079%2E791427%2EbD97j1)
I’m sure you remember Liam Ramos, the little boy in the blue hat from the Minneapolis area who was used as bait by ICE to try to detain his family, who is in the US with an active asylum claim. The good news is that Liam and his father were recently released from ICE custody, and my friend and colleague Rep. Joaquin Castro accompanied them from Texas to Minnesota to reunite them with their community.
The judge who blocked their deportation and ordered their release called DHS’s treatment of the family as driven by "perfidious lust for unbridled power”. But that decision hasn't stopped the administration from continuing to try to deport this family to this day, in what is being described as a clear case of retaliation — **Liam Ramos exposed the depravity of this administration, and they’re looking for revenge.**
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4890?t=4&akid=2079%2E791427%2EbD97j1)
Aliya Rahman is a US citizen from South Minneapolis and disabled woman with autism who has suffered a brain injury. She was driving to an appointment at the traumatic brain injury center when she got stuck in a traffic jam caused by ICE vehicles.
As she tried to navigate her way around, an agent yelled, "Move, I will break your f'ing window." She was given conflicting threats and instructions until suddenly the glass of her passenger side window was shattered. She yelled "I am disabled!”, and an agent responded, "Too late."
An agent pulled out a large knife, cut off her seatbelt, threw her face-first into the ground and leaned on her back. Aliya says shooting pain went through her head, neck and wrists. They handcuffed her and carried her facedown through the street by her cuffed arms and legs. She was detained and denied medical attention.
I’m linking the [**full video**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4891?t=5&akid=2079%2E791427%2EbD97j1) of her testimony below, and I urge everyone to watch it:
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4891?t=6&akid=2079%2E791427%2EbD97j1)
I’m proud of Aliya for speaking out and sharing her experience, both with her arrest and what she saw inside the Whipple ICE facility in Minnesota.
And I’m proud of everyone in Minneapolis who is showing incredible courage by standing tall against this tyranny and the thugs who are patrolling our streets.
I share these stories because I know the right-wing dominated media won’t. Because I know shining a light on this administration’s fascist violence is the fastest route towards accountability. Because growing our movement to defeat the far-right is exactly what they fear.
As we continue this work, if you would like to support both our efforts on the ground in Minneapolis and our efforts to combat ICE in Congress, [**chip in to my campaign today. Your donation helps us keep up the fight and make sure there are no more heart-wrenching stories like these.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26-ice.vqNHfK&refcode=em260210-1-180&t=7&akid=2079%2E791427%2EbD97j1)
**[DONATE HERE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-feb26-ice.vqNHfK&refcode=em260210-1-180&t=8&akid=2079%2E791427%2EbD97j1)**
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

---

| | | | | | Hi, Peter,Today is Brianna’s 48th birthday; and like most days in our house, it started early with emails, spreadsheets, and planning how to make Colorado’s finances work better for everyday people.If you’re able, will you consider making a [**birthday contribution**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=6b99f87ea3&e=8249791cac) in Brianna’s honor?
**🎂**[ _**$210.26 for 2.10.26**_](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=73f37de221&e=8249791cac) _**!**_**🎁**[ _**$48.00 - a dollar a year**_](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=f06e3121a1&e=8249791cac)**💐**[ _**$19.78 to honor the year she was born**_](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=fdb9b8c236&e=8249791cac)**🕯️**[ _**$10.00 for Feb 10th!**_](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=445c87e08a&e=8249791cac) I’ve watched Brianna give years of her life to public service - not because it’s easy, but because she believes it matters. She does the unglamorous work. She asks the hard questions. She shows up, day after day, to fight for transparency, accountability, and fairness.What people don’t always see is how deeply she carries this work with her. Brianna’s work ethic is matched by real compassion. She worries about her neighbors and constituents the same way she worries about family. She worries about seniors trying to retire with dignity, about working families stretched thin, about whether government is truly doing its job. That responsibility doesn’t stop at the Capitol. It comes home with her.That’s why I believe so strongly in her campaign for State Treasurer. Colorado needs a Treasurer who is steady, detail oriented, and trustworthy. Someone who treats public dollars as a public responsibility and is willing to put in the work every single day.And this is why I’m asking for a donation to celebrate Brianna’s birthday! Your support helps her continue this campaign and bring the same care and discipline she’s shown as a legislator to the Treasurer’s office. She doesn’t take corporate dollars, so her campaign is fueled by people like you - and me. We make it possible for her to always stand by the people she represents, instead of big interests. Thank you for that. There are other ways, too, to support her campaign: Caucus and Assembly are where grassroots support truly counts. If you’re a registered Democrat, please take a moment to commit to caucus and assembly and help Brianna get on the ballot by [pledging here](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=3e8765624b&e=8249791cac)!Thank you for believing in Brianna, in public service, and in doing the work the right way. Let’s make her 48th year the best one yet! With gratitude,Brianna’s wife 💙
Brianna for Colorado State Treasurer

name: Katie Porter
subject: As governor, I’ll keep standing with workers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
Californians can’t afford leadership that sides with corporate interests over working people.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=40835%2E3422442%2Enc3fhG)
Peter,
I was proud to stand with United Nurses Associations of California and Union of Health Care Professionals workers on the picket line.
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260210_1_ak.mPcMGd&refcode=em20260210-40835&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=40835%2E3422442%2Enc3fhG)
Nursing is a calling, but it shouldn’t be a sacrifice of one’s own future. Our nurses work long hours to save lives and keep patients healthy—they deserve a fair contract that reflects their work.
To keep more nurses in this state, the solution is simple: Pay them what they deserve and protect the pensions that allow them to retire with dignity after a career of keeping us healthy.
As our next governor, I’ll keep standing with workers fighting for what they deserve. But not every candidate in this race can say that. Californians can’t afford leadership that sides with corporate interests over working people.

Friend, ICE was built on violence and racism, and it cannot be reformed. I grew up in Southwest Detroit, close to the U.S.-Canada border, and when ICE was created a little more than 20 years ago, agents stopped my neighbors in public asking for their immigration status. Back then, community members demanded Congress stop funding ICE, and started warning us that ICE is too militarized. They’re right: ICE and Border Patrol agents are terrorizing our communities with military-grade assault rifles, tear gas, and other weapons used only in war zones. Where do they get the money for this equipment, or for their $50,000 signing bonuses? From our government, using our tax dollars. Right now, Congress is negotiating and voting on how much of our tax dollars to send to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS)—which includes ICE and Border Patrol. Congress has a February 13 deadline to pass a new funding bill for DHS. **Republicans need Democrats’ votes in order to pass this bill, so Democrats have leverage here to stop our tax dollars from funding ICE terror.** **In addition to blocking this year’s funding for ICE and CBP, we need to push for policies that revoke the billions given to these agencies in last year’s Big Betrayal Bill.** That’s in line with what the American people are demanding, and Congresspeople have a duty to represent their constituents. On top of the billions of dollars already allocated to ICE for the year, Trump’s bill last year hugely expanded ICE and funded the agency, as well as Border Patrol, for many years. These agencies don’t need another cent.
Meanwhile, Congress made a $1 trillion cut to healthcare last year. Congress cannot keep investing in violence rather than healthcare and other needs.
Instead, my colleagues must listen to the people: a recent poll showed that **77% of Democrats want to abolish ICE completely.**
We know more training won’t fix this. The ICE agent who killed Renee Good was a trainer himself, who worked with Border Patrol and ICE for 19 years—nearly the entire duration of ICE’s existence.
**Instead of continuing the flow of funding with our tax dollars, Congress must end funding for ICE and Border Patrol.**
